WITH duplicados AS (

    SELECT 'plantas' AS tabla, 'nombre' AS campo,
           nombre::text AS valor, COUNT(*) AS repeticiones
    FROM public.plantas
    WHERE nombre IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY nombre
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'productos', 'codigo',
           codigo::text, COUNT(*)
    FROM public.productos
    WHERE codigo IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY codigo
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'materias_primas', 'nombre',
           nombre::text, COUNT(*)
    FROM public.materias_primas
    WHERE nombre IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY nombre
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'lotes_produccion', 'codigo',
           codigo::text, COUNT(*)
    FROM public.lotes_produccion
    WHERE codigo IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY codigo
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'clientes', 'correo',
           correo::text, COUNT(*)
    FROM public.clientes
    WHERE correo IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY correo
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'gastos', 'descripcion',
           descripcion::text, COUNT(*)
    FROM public.gastos
    WHERE descripcion IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY descripcion
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
resumen AS (
    SELECT
        tabla,
        campo,
        SUM(repeticiones - 1)::int AS total_duplicados,
        STRING_AGG(
            valor || ' (' || repeticiones || ' registros)',
            ', '
        ) AS valores_duplicados
    FROM duplicados
    GROUP BY tabla, campo
)
SELECT
    tabla,
    campo,
    total_duplicados,
    valores_duplicados,
    total_duplicados > 5 AS alerta_d4
FROM resumen
ORDER BY total_duplicados DESC;
